svg.title: UNO R3 pinout
svg.desc: Header pins of the ATmega328P UNO R3 with Arduino pin numbers, AVR port bits and alternate functions.
svg.text: ATmega328P · 5 V logic · 16 MHz · LED_BUILTIN = D13 (PB5)
SCL/SDA on the top header are the same copper as A5/A4. The DIP-28 part has no ADC6/ADC7.
Sources: ArduinoCore-avr variants/standard/pins_arduino.h, ATmega328P datasheet, Arduino A000066 datasheet and schematic.
